courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 掃描電子顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「離子—固體作用與濺射產率」與「TEM 薄片製備的厚度與損傷預算」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；掃描電子顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield" and "Thickness and damage budget of TEM lamella preparation" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scanning electron microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦離子—固體濺射、束流與光點取捨、液態金屬離子源、雙束幾何、TEM 薄片損傷與切削速率校正；掃描電子顯微鏡則以電子探針直徑預算、Everhart–Thornley 偵測、作用體積與放大率校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ion–solid sputtering, current versus spot size, liquid-metal ion sources, dual-beam geometry, TEM-lamella damage and milling-rate calibration; Scanning electron microscopes centres on probe-diameter budget, Everhart–Thornley detection, interaction volume and magnification calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」與「電子束、作用體積與訊號」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到掃描電子顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「充電、鍍膜、低真空與 EDS 激發體積」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” and “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scanning electron microscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Charging, coating, low vacuum and EDS excitation volume", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 聚焦離子束分析系統
history.text: 1970 年代液態金屬離子源在太空推進與表面分析研究中發展成熟，1979 年美國 Hughes Research Laboratories 的 Seliger 等人以鎵源展示次微米光點的掃描離子探針。1980 年代 FIB 用於光罩修補與積體電路修改，1990 年代 FEI 等公司把 FIB 與 SEM 結合成雙束系統，使 TEM 試片製備與失效分析成為半導體與材料實驗室的例行工作；2010 年代氙電漿 FIB 把大體積切削速度提高一個數量級以上，支援封裝與電池等大尺度截面。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Liquid-metal ion sources matured in the 1970s through space-propulsion and surface-analysis research, and in 1979 Seliger and colleagues at Hughes Research Laboratories demonstrated a scanning ion probe with a submicrometre spot from a gallium source. In the 1980s FIBs were used for mask repair and integrated-circuit modification, and in the 1990s FEI and others combined FIB and SEM into dual-beam systems that made TEM specimen preparation and failure analysis routine in semiconductor and materials laboratories; in the 2010s xenon plasma FIBs raised bulk removal rates by more than an order of magnitude for large cross-sections of packages and batteries. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「離子—固體作用與濺射產率」到「系統驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield" through "System acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
